part.text:
Fixed the in-place mutation in `Labels.DropMetricName` at `model/labels/labels.go:350`.

The change uses `ls[:i:i]` so `append` allocates a new backing array instead of shifting labels in the original shared slice, preventing duplicate/corrupted series in range queries.

Validated:
- `TestLabels_DropMetricName` passes (all label build tags).
- `TestRangeQuery` passes, including `drop-metric-name`.
- Full `./model/labels` and `./promql` suites only show the pre-existing, unrelated `operators.test` failure (confirmed present before the change).
